data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): [cross_task_interference] task-6 fixtures deliberately embody the antipattern. Add an AC asserting their path tests/fixtures/antipattern-chain/ falls within the anti-pattern-scan Scope Exclusions (both tests/ and fixtures/ exclusion globs apply) so a future live fix-bug scan does not self-report the frozen fixtures as confirmed candidates and spawn spurious follow-up tickets. Also confirm marker-gating (task-2b) means committing these fixtures/tests does not trip the new commit-msg hook.
